name: easytube
description: EasyTube - Your media. Your formats. Your flow.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace server && npm run lint:fix --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
